definitions.explanation: Egg whites whipped with sugar until stiff and foamy, used in baking and desserts. Also refers to baked confections made from this foam.

examples.japanese: ⟦{卵白|らんぱく}→卵白：11975_ranpaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧メレンゲ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I make meringue from egg whites.

examples.japanese: メレンゲ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しっかり→しっかり：01272_shikkari⟧⟦{泡立|あわだ}てる→泡立てる：06419_awadateru⟧。

⟦{砂糖|さとう}→砂糖：00884_satou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧⟦{加|くわ}え→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧、つや⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧メレンゲ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{仕上|しあ}げる→仕上げる：04664_shiageru⟧。
examples.english: Adding the sugar little by little, whip it into a glossy meringue.

notes:
Loanword (from French "meringue," via the Japanese pronunciation メレンゲ). A staple of Western-style baking; also eaten as light baked meringue cookies.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- メレンゲ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make meringue
- メレンゲ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{泡立|あわだ}てる→泡立てる：06419_awadateru⟧: to whip meringue
- メレンゲ{菓子|がし}: meringue confection

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{生|なま}クリーム→生クリーム：15884_namakuriimu⟧: whipped cream — also whipped, but from cream, not egg whites
- ⟦スポンジ→スポンジ：04505_suponji⟧⟦{生地|きじ}→生地：02631_kiji⟧: sponge batter — uses whole beaten eggs rather than egg-white foam alone
